_readme: Site-wide settings that change over time. social: the Faith Works PH Facebook page, Instagram and LinkedIn, rendered as icon links wherever a page has data-fw-render="social" (footer, Home, Community, About). icon must be one of: facebook, instagram, linkedin, youtube. Only add a channel once its URL is confirmed. community: the Faith Works Facebook GROUP (the community space, distinct from the page), rendered as its own 'Join the community' panel wherever a page has data-fw-render="community-cta" (Home, Community, About).

community.title: The Faith Works Community
community.text: A space to keep learning, share what you're applying, and stay connected between events.
